message.content:
{
  "page_id": "page-01",
  "page_type": "other",
  "page_name": "Policy Personalization",
  "purpose": "A multi-step application form for InsurIntel AI that allows users to input vehicle details, usage patterns, and budget preferences to generate personalized insurance policy recommendations using AI-driven assessment.",
  "navigation_to": ["Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Resources", "Login", "Get Started", "About", "Careers", "Press", "Contact", "Privacy", "Terms", "Security"],
  "color_palette": {
    "background": "#F5F7FA",
    "surface": "#FFFFFF",
    "text_primary": "#111827",
    "text_secondary": "#6B7280",
    "accent": "#1D4ED8",
    "border": "#E5E7EB"
  },
  "typography": {
    "heading_font": "Inter (sans-serif)",
    "body_font": "Inter (sans-serif)",
    "heading_size_px": 36,
    "body_size_px": 16,
    "heading_weight": 700,
    "body_weight": 400
  },
  "layout": {
    "max_width_px": 1200,
    "container": "centered",
    "columns": 2,
    "header_present": true,
    "footer_present": true,
    "sidebar_present": false,
    "sections": [
      "Header Navigation",
      "Hero Section with Progress Bar",
      "Main Content Grid (Vehicle Config + Risk Profile)",
      "Secondary Content Grid (Usage Pattern + Monthly Budget)",
      "Trust Indicators / Feature Highlights",
      "Footer"
    ]
  },
  "header": {
    "present": true,
    "logo_text": "InsurIntel AI",
    "nav_items": ["Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Resources"],
    "right_side": ["Login", "Get Started"],
    "background_color": "#FFFFFF",
    "sticky": true
  },
  "hero": {
    "present": true,
    "headline": "Policy Personalization",
    "subheadline": "Tailor your motor insurance coverage with our AI-driven assessment. Precision underwriting starts with the right data.",
    "primary_cta": null,
    "secondary_cta": null
  },
  "content_sections": [
    {
      "name": "Application Progress",
      "type": "stats",
      "heading": null,
      "subheading": null,
      "items": ["Application Progress: 75%"],
      "layout": "rows"
    },
    {
      "name": "Vehicle Configuration Form",
      "type": "form",
      "heading": "Vehicle Configuration",
      "subheading": null,
      "items": [
        "Vehicle Type: Car | Bike",
        "Brand/Make: Select Manufacturer",
        "Model Name: e.g., Model S Plaid",
        "Purchase Year: 2024"
      ],
      "layout": "grid-2"
    },
    {
      "name": "Risk Profile Sidebar",
      "type": "content_blocks",
      "heading": "Risk Profile",
      "subheading": "Our AI uses historical claim data to optimize your premium pricing in real-time.",
      "items": [
        "Previous Claims (Last 3 Years): None | 1-2 | 3+",
        "AI Insight: Safe Driver Discount: Active"
      ],
      "layout": "columns"
    },
    {
      "name": "Usage Pattern Selection",
      "type": "steps",
      "heading": "Usage Pattern",
      "subheading": null,
      "items": ["Personal", "Business", "Commercial"],
      "layout": "grid-3"
    },
    {
      "name": "Monthly Budget Slider",
      "type": "form",
      "heading": "Monthly Budget",
      "subheading": null,
      "items": ["Coverage Intensity Slider ($145/mo)", "Generate Recommendations Button"],
      "layout": "rows"
    },
    {
      "name": "Trust Features",
      "type": "features_grid",
      "heading": null,
      "subheading": null,
      "items": [
        "Guaranteed Best Rates: AI-optimized pricing ensures you never pay for coverage you don't need.",
        "Instant Underwriting: Skip the 48-hour wait. Get your policy recommendation in under 60 seconds.",
        "24/7 AI Concierge: Need help? Our intelligent support agent is ready to assist at any step."
      ],
      "layout": "grid-3"
    }
  ],
  "footer": {
    "present": true,
    "columns": ["PLATFORM", "COMPANY", "LEGAL"],
    "links": ["Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Resources", "About", "Careers", "Press", "Contact", "Privacy", "Terms", "Security"],
    "copyright_text": "© 2024 InsurIntel AI. Precision Underwriting for the Modern Era.",
    "social_icons": ["globe", "settings", "accessibility"],
    "background_color": "#FFFFFF"
  },
  "forms": [
    {
      "name": "Vehicle Configuration",
      "fields": [
        { "label": "Vehicle Type", "type": "radio_group", "placeholder": null, "required": true },
        { "label": "Brand / Make", "type": "select", "placeholder": "Select Manufacturer", "required": true },
        { "label": "Model Name", "type": "text", "placeholder": "e.g., Model S Plaid", "required": true },
        { "label": "Purchase Year", "type": "text", "placeholder": "2024", "required": true }
      ],
      "submit_button_label": null
    }
  ],
  "buttons": [
    { "label": "Get Started", "style": "primary", "location": "header" },
    { "label": "Car", "style": "outline", "location": "Vehicle Configuration" },
    { "label": "Bike", "style": "ghost", "location": "Vehicle Configuration" },
    { "label": "None", "style": "primary", "location": "Risk Profile" },
    { "label": "1-2", "style": "ghost", "location": "Risk Profile" },
    { "label": "3+", "style": "ghost", "location": "Risk Profile" },
    { "label": "Personal", "style": "primary", "location": "Usage Pattern" },
    { "label": "Business", "style": "ghost", "location": "Usage Pattern" },
    { "label": "Commercial", "style": "ghost", "location": "Usage Pattern" },
    { "label": "Generate Recommendations →", "style": "primary", "location": "Monthly Budget" }
  ],
  "icons": [
    "car-icon",
    "bike-icon",
    "shield-checkmark",
    "lightning-bolt",
    "home-icon",
    "briefcase-icon",
    "van-icon",
    "credit-card-icon",
    "shield-star",
    "zap-circle",
    "headset-icon"
  ],
  "images": [],
  "animations_interactions": [
    "Progress bar fill animation at 75%",
    "Hover states on all interactive buttons",
    "Slider interaction for monthly budget",
    "Toggle selection states for Vehicle Type and Usage Pattern cards"
  ],
  "responsive_cues": [
    "Two-column layout for main form area collapses to single column on mobile",
    "Trust indicators stack vertically on smaller screens",
    "Footer columns stack vertically on mobile"
  ],
  "notes": "The page uses a clean, professional SaaS aesthetic with a blue accent color (#1D4ED8). The 'Risk Profile' section is visually distinct as a blue card to draw attention to the AI insights. The 'Usage Pattern' section uses large icon-based cards for easy selection."
}
